Hoffman's Pizza Balls (Frozen)

Ingredients:
6 frozen Hoffman's pizza balls

Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 425°F.
2. Arrange the frozen pizza balls in a single layer on a baking sheet.
3. Bake 12-15 minutes, until golden and the cheese is melted.
4. Rest 2 minutes before eating — the cheese inside is very hot.
note: Store-bought frozen staple, 1 serving = about 6 balls. No package information for this product could be found online at all — the directions in the text are standard bake-from-frozen placeholders.
